steps.text: Uniform motion means moving at a constant speed in a straight line. Let's watch what that looks like.
See how it covers equal distances in equal times — the same gap every second. That's the sign of uniform motion.
Because the speed never changes, the distance-time graph is a straight line. Steady speed, straight line, equal steps.

coach.mission: Watch an object move at a constant speed.
whenStuck: Tap “Start” and watch the object move.
Check the distance it covers in each second.
whenWrong: Uniform motion covers equal distances in equal times — the speed stays constant.
A constant speed gives a straight distance-time graph.
whenCorrect: Right — equal distances in equal times means uniform motion.
coach.done: You've seen uniform linear motion. Explore non-uniform motion next, or move on when you're ready.
